author: TEDx Talks
description:
Everyone fears AI will replace us. But after three studies on AI and work, Daniele Quercia fears something quieter: that AI will take over the imaginative, joyful parts of our jobs and leave us with the admin. The risk is not mass unemployment, but mass demoralization. So when AI reshapes your work, will you still recognize yourself in it? Daniele Quercia asks: what if AI isn't coming for the boring parts of your job, but the parts you love? His latest research finds that the tasks workers describe as creative, joyful, and theirs are the ones most exposed to AI. 

Across his work, he asks a simple question: what would technology look like if it cared not only about efficiency, but also about people's wellbeing? He first explored this idea at TED with "happy maps”, which reroute you through a city's most beautiful streets rather than the fastest. He directs Responsible AI at Nokia Bell Labs in Cambridge and teaches at Politecnico di Torino and King’s College London. Fortune named him a
title: Will AI take the joy out of work? | Daniele Quercia | TEDxBerlin

author: TEDx Talks
description: In her compelling TEDx talk, Minh An Phan addresses the growing "epidemic of nonchalance"—a cultural shift where apathy is mistaken for composure and caring deeply is seen as a liability. She unpacks how guarding ourselves behind indifference stifles authentic human connection, empathy, and personal fulfillment. Ultimately, Phan offers a powerful challenge to dismantle this emotional defense mechanism and reclaim the courage it takes to care. Anna is an exceptional and proactive student who’s deeply involved in her community. In 2023, Anna founded her own dance team, The Spice, inspiring creative expression through dance in Wellspring Saigon. As the Student Council President, she launched a peer studying program - WISers Connect that promoted a positive learning culture in school. Apart from her academic life, Anna is tremendously dedicated to performing arts, specifically dance and choreography as a member of SpaceX Dance Group. With appearances in several iconic music videos and liv
title: The epidemic of nonchalance | An Phan Minh | TEDxWellspring Saigon School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Volunteering may begin with the desire to help others, but its impact often reaches much further than we expect. In this talk, the speaker explores how giving our time and skills can change not only the lives of others but also our own perspectives, relationships, and sense of purpose. Through the unexpected lessons of service, discover how small acts of kindness can create meaningful connections, challenge assumptions, and inspire lasting change. Because sometimes, when we volunteer to make a difference in someone else’s life, we discover a difference within ourselves. **Personal Bio**

A seasoned leader, community advocate, and technology professional, [Name] brings together a passion for innovation, cultural preservation, entrepreneurship, and community engagement.

As a leader of a North American nonprofit organization representing more than 70 Tamil associations across the United States and Canada, [Name] has played a significant role in strengthening community connections and pr
title: What Happens When You Volunteer? | Vijay Manivel | TEDxKings Mills Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Our ability to be creative is not lost, but it is often hidden by our cognitive habits. By explaining the flow of new ideas in the brain and in the mind, as well as what hinders it, and by showing why we should see uncertainty as a resource, rather than a threat, this talk demonstrates what it takes to reclaim our inherent capacity for innovation. Moshe is a cognitive neuroscientist at Bar-Ilan University and Massachusetts Hospital. He was previously the head of the Gonda Multidisciplinary Brain Research Center at Bar-Ilan University and before that director of the Cognitive Neuroscience Laboratory at Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital. His research focuses on various aspects of brain function, including memory, foresight, mental load, mind-wandering, mood, and creativity. He has published over 90 research articles, edited two scientific books and published the popular science book Mindwandering. 

His writing to the public has appeared in numerous platforms, in
title: Why smart people stop having original ideas | Moshe Bar, Ph.D. | TEDxInnovation Drive

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dr. Winter makes the case that the most common failure in innovation isn’t bad science or lack of resources. It’s smart people asking questions that are too small. He shows why the breakthrough is never the end of the story, and why the question that separates great innovators from brilliant failures is not “did we solve it?” but “did we solve the right thing? Chief Scientist at RTX, the largest Aerospace and defense company, (merger of Raytheon and United Technologies) where he shapes the company’s cross-enterprise technology strategy and accelerates innovation across aerospace and defense. 

With 45 years of experience, Dr. Winter work has enabled major commercial and military aircraft platforms with technologies spanning fuel cells, lasers, combustion, and propulsion systems. The inventor on more than 50 patents and over 50 technical articles, a fellow of AIAA and the Royal Aeronautical Society, and a member of the Connecticut Academy of Science & Engineering.  He is widely respect
title: What 45 Years Taught Me About Doing it Wrong | Dr. Michael Winter | TEDxInnovation Drive

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Laughter in a classroom makes the learner feel safe and helps to build a stronger relationship among pupils and educators. This talk outlines, how comic relief acts as a bridge to scaffold learning and improve engagement. Babar Haneef is an inspiring educational leader with 16 years of experience, having taught 18,000+ students and trained 10,000+ teachers. He is passionate about empowering educators and inspiring young people through education, public speaking, youth diplomacy, theatre, and literature.
At heart, he is a teacher committed to empowering others and giving young people a voice. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Laughter The hidden curriculum | Babar Haneef | TEDxThe City School Islamabad Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Em sua palestra “A mecânica do silenciamento: quem decide o que uma mulher pode ser?”, a speaker aborda como estruturas sociais, econômicas e culturais contribuem para a manutenção das desigualdades de gênero e para o silenciamento das mulheres. A partir de reflexões sobre o papel feminino na economia, o capitalismo emocional e a influência do patriarcado, a apresentação explora os mecanismos que condicionam a liberdade, a autonomia e as possibilidades de atuação das mulheres na sociedade. Inspirada no pensamento da escritora e ativista bell hooks, a palestra evidencia os impactos políticos, econômicos e corporais dessas relações de poder, convidando o público a questionar padrões historicamente estabelecidos e a reconhecer a importância da resistência e da transformação social na construção de uma sociedade mais igualitária. Estudante da 3ª Série do Ensino Médio do Colégio Medianeira. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a
title: A mecânica do silenciamento | Ana Paula Bini Scholl | TEDxColégio Medianeira Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: A speaker Monique, em sua palestra “Exclusão Social no Urbanismo: Arquitetura Hostil”, aborda como o planejamento urbano pode contribuir para a exclusão social, especialmente de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. A partir de exemplos como o Viaduto Capanema, em Curitiba, a estudante questiona o uso de estruturas arquitetônicas que impedem a permanência de pessoas em espaços públicos. Ao relacionar arquitetura, matemática e questões sociais, apresenta o projeto PermaneSER, iniciativa que incentiva a identificação de espaços hostis e a criação de alternativas mais inclusivas. A palestra convida o público a refletir sobre o direito à cidade e a importância de construir espaços que promovam acolhimento, dignidade e pertencimento. Estudante da 3ª Série do Ensino Médio do Colégio Medianeira. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Exclusão e Arquitetura Hostil | Monique Nicolli Santos das Neves | TEDxColégio Medianeira Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: A speaker Isabelli Valiente Gomes, em sua palestra “O teatro como um caminho para a saúde mental”, aborda a importância da expressão artística como ferramenta de promoção do bem-estar emocional, diante dos crescentes desafios relacionados à saúde mental no Brasil. A partir de dados sobre o aumento dos transtornos de ansiedade, das dificuldades de acesso ao acompanhamento psicológico e dos preconceitos que ainda cercam a busca por ajuda, a apresentação explora o potencial da arte para reduzir a ansiedade, fortalecer a autoestima e ressignificar experiências. Inspirada nas ideias de Augusto Boal e na proposta do Teatro-Fórum, a estudante destaca como o teatro pode transformar vivências individuais em possibilidades de reflexão e construção coletiva. A palestra convida o público a reconhecer a arte não apenas como manifestação estética, mas também como espaço de acolhimento, autoconhecimento e transformação, capaz de fortalecer vínculos, promover autonomia e contribuir para uma relação m
title: O teatro e a saúde mental | Isabelli Valiente Gomes da Rocha | TEDxColégio Medianeira Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: O speaker Henrique Gonçalves Mattos Beltrão, em sua palestra “O pálido ponto azul e a experiência humana”, propõe uma reflexão sobre a existência humana e nosso lugar no universo, a partir da célebre fotografia da Terra registrada pela sonda Voyager 1, em 1990. Inspirado nas ideias dos astrofísicos Carl Sagan e Neil deGrasse Tyson, o estudante explora como a imensidão do cosmos pode transformar nossa percepção sobre a vida, a humanidade e a importância de nossas experiências. Ao estabelecer conexões com o pensamento filosófico de Immanuel Kant, a arte de Caspar David Friedrich e as palavras de Anne Frank, a apresentação amplia a discussão para questões relacionadas à sensibilidade, à condição humana e à capacidade de reconhecer a beleza e o valor da existência. A palestra convida o público a refletir sobre como, mesmo diante da aparente insignificância da Terra na vastidão do universo, nossas relações, escolhas e atitudes podem atribuir significado à experiência humana. Estudante da 2
title: O pálido ponto azul | Henrique Gonçalves Mattos Beltrão | TEDxColégio Medianeira Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Alice Curti Czajka, em sua palestra, aborda a relação entre o movimento punk e o capitalismo, questionando se essa expressão de rebeldia foi mercantilizada ao longo do tempo ou se já surgiu vinculada à lógica capitalista. A partir de reflexões sobre a origem do movimento e a influência de figuras como Vivienne Westwood e Malcolm McLaren na trajetória da banda Sex Pistols, a apresentação evidencia como o punk utilizou o próprio sistema que criticava para disseminar suas ideias e contestar padrões sociais. Ao mesmo tempo, destaca como o capitalismo transformou essa rebeldia em oportunidade de lucro. A palestra convida o público a refletir sobre as contradições entre resistência cultural e interesses comerciais, mostrando que a relação entre o punk e o capitalismo é mais complexa do que uma simples oposição. Estudante da 3ª Série do Ensino Médio do Colégio Medianeira. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Lea
title: O punk se mercantilizou? | Alice Curti Czajka | TEDxColégio Medianeira Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: O speaker Miguel Elias Neto aborda a diferença entre a música como expressão artística e a música produzida com objetivos comerciais, questionando a ideia de que não se faz mais música como antigamente. A partir de reflexões sobre a indústria musical e a influência do mercado na criação de canções, a apresentação explora o contraste entre obras que nascem de sentimentos e experiências pessoais e aquelas desenvolvidas para alcançar o sucesso comercial. Ao comparar músicas como “Mr. Brightside”, da banda The Killers, e “Jetski”, de Pedro Sampaio, a palestra convida o público a refletir sobre a autenticidade na música e reconhecer a importância de distinguir a expressão artística das estratégias de consumo e entretenimento. Estudante da 2ª Série do Ensino Médio do Colégio Medianeira. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: O preço de transformar arte em produto | Miguel Elias Neto | TEDxColégio Medianeira Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: l'orateur démontre comment transformer l'expérience d'hier en levier d'innovation pour demain. Il ne s'agit plus seulement d'enseigner des savoirs, mais d'éveiller les consciences et de bâtir un modèle éducatif adapté aux défis de demain. Une invitation stimulante à repenser l'éducation par la force de l'inspiration. Sèdami Agboton est un acteur engagé de l'éducation et de la formation, fort d'une expérience avec le Consortium International de Développement en Éducation (CIDE Canada). Expert en leadership, il a dédié sa carrière à promouvoir l'éducation de qualité et à développer les compétences des jeunes et professionnels. À travers l'Académie du Leadership, il a conçu des programmes novateurs pour former des leaders influents, incluant l'Académie du Leadership Junior pour les jeunes de 6 à 16 ans, visant à préparer la prochaine génération d'agents de changement. Convaincu de l'impact de l'éducation sur la transformation sociétale, il milite pour des environnements d'apprentissage i
title: De la mémoire collective aux modèles éducatifs de demain  | SEDAMI AGBOTON | TEDxCotonou

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Quand l'art culinaire japonais rencontre les saveurs du Bénin. L'essence du poisson frais. Quand le savoir-faire du Japon dialogue avec la richesse des produits béninois, la gastronomie devient un pont entre deux cultures. À travers le prisme du poisson frais, ingrédient roi des deux traditions , un chef japonais nous invite à un voyage créatif inédit.
En associant la précision nippone aux saveurs authentiques du Bénin, l'orateur démontre comment l'art culinaire peut marier respect des traditions, sublimation des produits locaux et innovation. Une célébration poétique du goût, de la fraîcheur et du partage interculturel. Chef renommé pour ses talents exceptionnels en cuisine japonaise, Jun Okamoto a exercé dans les plus hautes sphères de la gastronomie. Diplômé de l’UTSUNOMIYA Junior College High School en arts culinaires, il a perfectionné son art au Restaurant Omiya à Tokyo. Il a ensuite été chef de résidence officielle pour des ambassadeurs japonais à Vancouver, au Malawi et au Bén
title: Quand l'art culinaire japonais rencontre les saveurs du Bénin. | JUN OKAMOTO | TEDxCotonou

author: TEDx Talks
description:
"Elles meurent nombreuses en donnant la vie. Nous en sommes tous concernés." 
Chaque jour, de trop nombreuses femmes perdent la vie en accomplissant l'acte ultime de donner la naissance. Face à cette réalité tragique, ce talk brise le silence sur la santé maternelle et rappelle une vérité fondamentale : la mortalité maternelle n'est pas un problème de femmes, c'est un enjeu de société qui nous touche tous.
L'orateur pose un diagnostic sans concession et appelle à une prise de conscience collective urgente. Un plaidoyer puissant pour agir, protéger la vie et garantir à chaque mère le droit de donner la vie en toute sécurité. Né en 1966 à Malanville, Dr. Eugène ZOUMENOU est Professeur Titulaire en Anesthésie-Réanimation à l'Université d'Abomey-Calavi (UAC) et Chef de la Clinique Universitaire d’Anesthésie-Réanimation au CNHU-HKM. Diplômé Médecin d’État en 1994, agrégé en 2012, il s'est spécialisé dans l’anesthésie-réanimation pour la mère et l’enfant. Ancien Vice-Doyen de la FSS et Dire
title: Elles meurent nombreuses en donnant la vie.  | Dr. Eugène ZOUMENOU | TEDxCotonou

author: TEDx Talks
description: Une réflexion puissante pour semer dès aujourd'hui les graines d'un avenir harmonieux et durable pour les générations futures. Esther Awanabi IDRISSOU est une passionnée de numérique, médias et d’agriculture. Elle y construit sa carrière professionnelle en initiant le média Agriyouth (www.agri-youth.com ). Sa conviction est que les TIC et l’accès à l’information sont un levier au service des communautés. Elle met donc ses capacités en communication et marketing. À travers son organisation Agriyouth development, elle a accompagné plus d'une cinquantaine d'agripreneurs. En 2019 elle est nommée par le Ministère de l’Economie Numérique et de la Digitalisation (MEND) parmi les femmes les plus influentes dans leur communauté grâce au numérique. En 2021 son média remporte le prix de meilleur média faisant la promotion de la consommation des produits locaux. Sa vision est de mettre en place une industrie médiatique au service du développement durable (agricole et environnemental) et du bien-ê
title: Semer pour demain: réconcilier l'homme et la terre | Esther Awanabi IDRISSOU | TEDxCotonou

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this talk, Yashashvi Sharma explores the importance of discovering your authentic voice and building a personal brand in the age of artificial intelligence. Drawing from her experience of forgetting her topic during a Hindi extempore competition in eighth grade, she highlights the difference between knowing what to say and having the confidence to express it. She introduces the QUERENCIA framework, built around nine pillars: Quintessential Beliefs, Unique Value, Expertise and Evidence, Reputation and Recognition, Expression and Language, Narrative and Journey, Connection and Community, Impression and Impact, and Aspiration and Alignment. She also discusses how AI can support communication without replacing independent thinking, personal experiences, or individual identity. Her message encourages audiences to understand their strengths, communicate their value, and build a professional identity rooted in authenticity, substance, and trust. Yashashavi Sharma is a Performance Strategi
title: TedxGGI : Find Your Voice Before AI Finds It for You | Yashashavi Sharma | TEDxGGI

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Drawing from her personal experience of displacement during the Boko Haram insurgency in Borno State, Aisha Damboa challenges the narrative that defines women in humanitarian crises merely as survivors. Through her journey from displacement to founding ZEGCAWIS, she demonstrates how women can transform lived experiences into community-led solutions, advancing girls’ education, menstrual health, and economic empowerment. She argues that women's leadership in crisis settings must move beyond responding to adversity towards shaping the future, building institutions, and driving lasting change. Aishatu Kabu is a civic leader and gender advocate from northeastern Nigeria committed to empowering women and girls as agents of change. As Founder and Executive Director of ZEGCAWIS and Director of Women for NECSOB Borno, she champions girls’ education, GBV prevention, women peace and security, and accountable governance.
Her work has earned global recognition including participation at the UN CS
title: From Survival to Leadership: Women in Crisis | Aishatu Kabu | TEDxMaiduguri
